Isn't that wonderful???

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE v1.10 | Desktop Mark is now free with Magic!
notes.notes:
oh hi,

[i]NOTE: The game was released to Free earlier than I woke up!! Haha[/i]

Desktop Mark is now free with Magic! Those who have had the game in the past will receive the Magic DLC for free. The merchant couldn't scramble up some mark bucks for your troubles, so I apologise for that.

[b]New stuff:[/b]
[list]
[*] 12 new hats!
[*] 5 new marks!
[*] New Chess minigame
[*] New Break-it minigame
[*] Magic DLC
[*] More magic effects on hats & skins
[*] A "suppliers" ticker showing everyone who has Magic
[*] A new Mark Card that you can use to show off to your friends
[*] New menu theme(s) for Magic
[*] A TON of bug fixes!
[/list]

[b]The Magic DLC includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Magic effects on hats & skins
[*] On-demand minigames (used to be included)
[*] 20% off every merchant item (used to be included)
[*] Special menu & card theme
[*] Be listed as a supplier for everyone
[*] Re-roll the minigame wheel (used to be included)
[/list]

Have fun!

[i]p.s. use code MAGIC[/i]

notes.title: Desktop Mark is becoming FREE with DLC
notes.notes:
oh hi,

To help bring more people into the realm of Mark, I've decided to make the game free in an upcoming update. This is because, when asking many people, they often said that they would get the game if it was free.

[b]Don't worry![/b] Anyone who has the game currently will get the DLC for free (it'll be the same price as the current version), along with an OG badge on your new *card* and 1,000 Mark bucks.

This does [b]NOT[/b] introduce any micro-transactions. Mark bucks will forever remain a currency in a separate realm to our economy.

I'm still working on adding more content to the game, so expect these changes & a ton of new stuff in a week or two.

Cheers,
coding398

notes.title: v1.02 but I forgot to change it, so v1.01 2!
notes.notes:
One day after v1.01, we have another update!
This time, it would have been v1.02 if I hadn't forgotten to update the version number in-game. That also means that the Worker Cap isn't 70% off today, such a shame.

Not that big of a patch this time:
[list]
[*] Added Turkish language
[*] Added Russian language (experimental, UI overflows sometimes)
[*] Attempted to fix store tab glitch
[*] Fixed one of Eriko's obscure cheats
[/list]

If you're still encountering any issues, please join the official Discord [url=https://discord.gg/YucjM4gqrx]here![/url]

That's it until the next time Eriko finds another bug.
[b]Cheers! Don't forget to review the game (honestly).[/b]

notes.title: Desktop Mark is released!
notes.notes:
[b]🎉 Desktop Mark is now available on Steam for $2.99 USD (15% sale for release!) 🥳[/b]

Now you can get yourself a little Mark to bounce around your screen, play minigames, and customise!
I wish you all a lot of fun with the game and anticipation for future updates! 👀

Go ahead, Make Mark's day & buy Desktop Mark for yourself or a friend, or both!
